y4b69afd0616.add: - **Granville Austin:** DPSPs and FRs are "aimed at furthering the goals of the **social revolution**" (APPSC G2 2008).

ycc53ad5d23f.add: - **Education across the Constitution** (UPSC 2012 – all five): DPSP Art. 45; Panchayats/Municipalities (11th, 12th Schedules); Fifth and Sixth Schedules (tribal areas); Seventh Schedule (Concurrent Entry 25).

yad900e804bb.add: - **State of Punjab v. Jagjit Singh (Oct 2016):** "equal pay for equal work" applies to **temporary employees** doing the same work as regular ones.

y7bf12005e26.add: - **'New Magna Carta' for DPSPs:** attribution **unsettled** (key grids give Pylee/Ambedkar); 'Magna Carta of India' usually = **Part III (FRs)**.

yac87bbc87cc.add: - **AP (Mar 2023):** Cabinet approved Mandal Legal Services Committees for **Anaparthi, Piduguralla and Mydukur** (Palnadu is a district, not a mandal).

y9cf3bbcbd29.add: - **B.N. Rau (1946):** DPSPs are "in the nature of **moral precepts for the authorities of the State**" – they have at least an educative value.

y00ca64461d7.add: - **Planning Commission (Mar 1950):** set up by a Cabinet resolution in pursuance of the DPSPs – **Art. 39** (and the Art. 38 aim) – not by any Article or Act.

yf9867a003dd.add: - **First national meet of DLSAs:** 30-31 July **2022**, Vigyan Bhawan, **New Delhi** (NALSA).
